name: Snuffle themes
description: Combines the token files into the four themes of the prototype: platform (iOS, Android) x scheme (light, dark). Later sources override earlier ones. scripts/build-tokens.mjs reads this file and writes src/design-system/theme/theme.generated.ts.

foundation.description: Primitives and the semantic tokens every theme shares.

platform.description: iOS is the default (decision 021); Android follows Material 3 where the values differ.

scheme.description: Light and dark colour roles on Biscuit grey with Pastel parade and Indigo (decision 036).
